steps.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()];local q=Map.GetPlot(p:GetCities():GetCapitalCity():GetX(),p:GetCities():GetCapitalCity():GetY());local values={};for _,name in ipairs({'GetOwner','GetTerrainType','GetImprovementType','GetDistrictType','IsCity','IsWater','IsMountain','IsImpassable'}) do local ok,v=pcall(function() return q[name](q) end);values[#values+1]=name..'='..(ok and tostring(v) or (tostring(v):gsub('[%c].*',''))) end;print('[JAC_PLOT_CORE_API] '..table.concat(values,','));return table.concat(values,',')

local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()];local range=assert(tonumber(GlobalParameters.CITY_MIN_RANGE),'city spacing unavailable');local site;for i=0,Map.GetPlotCount()-1 do local q=Map.GetPlotByIndex(i);if q:GetOwner()==p:GetID() and not q:IsWater() and not q:IsMountain() and not q:IsImpassable() and not q:IsNaturalWonder() and not q:IsCity() and q:GetDistrictType()==-1 and q:GetImprovementType()==-1 then local near=99999;for _,owner in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveIDs()) do for _,city in Players[owner]:GetCities():Members() do near=math.min(near,Map.GetPlotDistance(q:GetX(),q:GetY(),city:GetX(),city:GetY())) end end;if near>range and (not site or near>site.Distance) then site={X=q:GetX(),Y=q:GetY(),Index=i,Distance=near} end end end;assert(site,'no valid empty cache plot beyond city spacing');ExposedMembers.JAC_CustodyProbeSite=function() return site end;print('[JAC_NATIVE_CACHE_SITE] plot='..site.Index..' nearest='..site.Distance..' minimum='..range);return 'selected native cache site '..site.Index

local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()];local coords=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_CustodyProbeSite());local site=Map.GetPlotByIndex(coords.Index);local before={};for _,w in ipairs(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption.OwnedGreatWorkSlots(p:GetID())) do before[w.Index]=true end;local cap=p:GetCities():GetCapitalCity();local b=assert(GameInfo.Buildings['BUILDING_JAC_ABSORPTION_CACHE']);if not cap:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(b.Index) then cap:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteBuilding(b.Index,Map.GetPlot(cap:GetX(),cap:GetY()):GetIndex(),100) end;p:AttachModifierByID('GOODY_CULTURE_GRANT_ONE_RELIC');local count=p:GetCities():GetCount();local ok,created=pcall(function() return p:GetCities():Create(coords.X,coords.Y) end);print('[JAC_NATIVE_CACHE_CREATE_API] ok='..tostring(ok)..' result='..tostring(created)..' current='..tostring(CityManager.GetCityAt(coords.X,coords.Y)));assert(ok,tostring(created));Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_CUSTODY_PROBE',{Owner=p:GetID(),BeforeCityCount=count,Source={X=cap:GetX(),Y=cap:GetY(),ID=cap:GetID()},Cache={X=coords.X,Y=coords.Y},Building=b.Index,Before=before});print('[JAC_NATIVE_CACHE_CREATE_REQUEST] before='..count..' after='..p:GetCities():GetCount());return 'requested native cache creation before checking publication'

condition.code: local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_CUSTODY_PROBE');local c=t and CityManager.GetCityAt(t.Cache.X,t.Cache.Y);return c and c:GetOwner()==t.Owner

steps.code: local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_CUSTODY_PROBE');local c=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(t.Cache.X,t.Cache.Y),'native cache absent after publication');assert(c:GetOwner()==t.Owner);c:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteBuilding(t.Building,Map.GetPlot(t.Cache.X,t.Cache.Y):GetIndex(),100);t.Cache.ID=c:GetID();Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_CUSTODY_PROBE',t);return 'native cache published; granted an actual relic'

local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_CUSTODY_PROBE');local p=Players[t.Owner];local found;for _,city in p:GetCities():Members() do for b in GameInfo.Buildings() do if city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(b.Index) then for slot=0,city:GetBuildings():GetNumGreatWorkSlots(b.Index)-1 do local w=city:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(b.Index,slot);if w and w>=0 and not t.Before[w] then assert(not found);found={Index=w,City=city:GetID(),Building=b.Index,Slot=slot} end end end end end;assert(found,'real relic not placed');assert(found.City~=t.Cache.ID,'relic must move from an existing city into custody');ExposedMembers.JAC_CustodyProbeRead=function() return found end;local params={};params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_PLAYER_ONE]=t.Owner;params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_SRC]=found.City;params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_CITY_DEST]=t.Cache.ID;params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_SRC]=found.Building;params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_BUILDING_DEST]=t.Building;params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_GREAT_WORK_INDEX]=found.Index;params[PlayerOperations.PARAM_SLOT]=0;UI.RequestPlayerOperation(t.Owner,PlayerOperations.MOVE_GREAT_WORK,params);return 'requested actual native relic move '..found.Index

condition.code: local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_CUSTODY_PROBE');local r=ExposedMembers.JAC_CustodyProbeRead and ExposedMembers.JAC_CustodyProbeRead();local c=t and Players[t.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(t.Cache.ID);return r and c and c:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(t.Building,0)==r.Index

steps.code: local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_CUSTODY_PROBE');local r=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_CustodyProbeRead());local free=assert(PlayerManager.GetFreeCitiesPlayerID());local c=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(t.Cache.X,t.Cache.Y));Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_CUSTODY_PROBE_WORK',{Index=r.Index,Free=free});CityManager.TransferCity(c,free);assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(t.Cache.X,t.Cache.Y):GetOwner()==free);return 'transferred native cache city to Free Cities '..free

local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_CUSTODY_PROBE');local w=Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_CUSTODY_PROBE_WORK');local c=CityManager.GetCityAt(t.Cache.X,t.Cache.Y);assert(c:GetOwner()==w.Free);assert(c:GetBuildings():GetGreatWorkInSlot(t.Building,0)==w.Index,'native work index changed during custody');print('[JAC_NATIVE_CUSTODY_SUCCESS] index='..w.Index..' owner='..w.Free);return 'same native work now held outside the absorber'
